_**Agent (copilot/gpt-5.3-codex)**_

Short answer: not from the inference endpoint we are using, Dr. Greg.

- For GitHub Models via `models.inference.ai.azure.com`, there is no standard “list available models for this token” endpoint that we can rely on at runtime.
- For GitHub Copilot (`api.githubcopilot.com/chat/completions`), there is also no stable public model-discovery endpoint we should depend on in app code.

So in practice, we keep an internal allowlist and optionally add a lightweight “probe” check (try a tiny completion) to validate that a model is actually available for your account before using it.
